given: self-hosted feature flag endpoint writes request values into sentry.conf.py as Python source and reloads the config

should_find.finding: PUT interpolates request.data values verbatim into SENTRY_FEATURES["flag"]=<value> lines in sentry.conf.py and then calls configure(), which executes the file, so a crafted value injects arbitrary Python that runs on the server

should_not_find: GET leaking the list of early features
